mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=#{id} AND status='active' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM user_entitlements WHERE user_id=#{user} AND starts_at <=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY starts_at DESC
SELECT * FROM user_entitlements WHERE user_id=#{user} AND code='pro' ORDER BY starts_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM membership_redemption_codes WHERE code_hash=#{hash} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE membership_redemption_codes SET redeemed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),redeemed_by_user_id=#{user} WHERE code_hash=#{hash} AND redeemed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(units),0) FROM feature_usage WHERE user_id=#{user} AND occurred_at>=#{from} AND occurred_at < #{until} AND result='allowed'
mapper.update: UPDATE feature_usage SET result='provider_failed' WHERE user_id=#{user} AND request_id=#{request} AND result='allowed'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rate_limit_buckets(bucket_key,window_start,hits,expires_at) VALUES(#{key},#{window},1,#{expires}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hits=CASE WHEN window_start=#{window} THEN hits+1 ELSE 1 END,window_start=#{window},expires_at=#{expires}
mapper.select: SELECT hits FROM rate_limit_buckets WHERE bucket_key=#{key}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM rate_limit_buckets WHERE expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET display_name=#{name},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{user} AND status='active'
mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,expires_at,created_at FROM refresh_sessions WHERE user_id=#{user} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_sessions SET revoked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id=#{user} AND id=#{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
